From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + recommended next steps to finish trial setup

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery + a simple unblock plan so you can get usable traffic into the trial cluster this week: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: validate end-to-end latency and cost per inference for the recommendation pipeline (10k QPS simulated).
- Constraint: security team requires VPC egress rules and a short SOC-related questionnaire answered before load testing.
- Success criteria: <10% tail latency over 95th percentile under a 5k token average payload; embedding cosine similarity baseline >= 0.92 on sample set.

Recommended next steps (30–60 min effort each)
1) Run quick environment check (Grace + Ben pairing): grant our trial cluster access, verify VPC rules — I attached a one-page checklist.
2) Upload sample data and confirm tokenization/seq-length distributions (Acme to upload S3 link).
3) Schedule a guided run with CS to exercise autoscaling and compare cost numbers live (we'll capture token counts and model variant metrics).

Proposed times for the pairing session (30 min): Wednesday 7/21 10:00–10:30am PT or Thursday 7/22 11:30–12:00pm PT. If neither works, tell me two windows that do and I’ll send invites.

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (setup checklist)

If priorities shifted since the call, please let me know — happy to push timelines or split the work into smaller bites.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0162

Grace looped me in; I’m Marissa on the Customer Success team and I run guided kickoffs. We’ve seen this exact VPC + SOC checklist pattern before and can short-circuit setup in one short session. I can host a 30-min guided setup that covers:

Agenda (30 min)
- 0–5m: quick introductions and confirmation of success criteria
- 5–15m: we walk through the redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx together and verify access/VPC rules
- 15–25m: test upload of a 500–1k sample payload and run a single inference + capture latency/cost metrics
- 25–30m: next steps and who owns each item (SOW draft + timeline)

I have an open slot today (Thu 7/22) 11:30–12:00pm PT and tomorrow (Fri 7/23) 9:00–9:30am PT. If you prefer an evening slot, we can accommodate that too.

I attached a short SOW draft (acme-sow-draft.docx) that outlines what the trial-facing deliverables look like and typical timelines — it’s editable.

If you cannot make either time, please reply with three windows that work for you and we'll prioritize. If priority has shifted, a one-line update helps us avoid unnecessary follow-ups.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you productive on the platform.

Best,
Marissa Cole
